title: my-states theme
description: A theme for my-states: structured values the application turns into its own CSS custom properties. Themes change how the application looks, never where panels sit. Every value is optional; the application derives what a theme leaves out.

schemaVersion.description: The theme format version this file is written for.

id.description: A stable identifier, unique in the local theme library. Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens.

name.description: The name shown in the theme picker.

derivedFrom.description: The id of the theme this one was based on. Informational only.

modes.description: The modes the theme supports. At least one of light or dark.

light.description: One mode of a theme: light or dark.

foundation.description: Low-level primitives the rest of the theme is derived from.

background.description: The base background colour of the whole application. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

foreground.description: The main text colour. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

muted.description: Secondary text. Derived from foreground when absent. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

faint.description: Tertiary text and captions. Derived from foreground when absent. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

accent.description: The attention colour: selection outlines and glows. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

border.description: The default border colour. Derived from foreground when absent. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

danger.description: Errors and destructive actions. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

selection.description: Canvas selection outline. Derived from accent when absent. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

typography.description: Font stacks. Only fonts already available to the browser; no remote fonts.

uiFont.description: The interface font stack. A CSS font-family stack. Only fonts already available to the browser. Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

headingFont.description: The font stack for panel titles, note titles and dialog headings. The interface font when absent. A CSS font-family stack. Only fonts already available to the browser. Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

headingWeight.description: The weight of panel titles, e.g. "500" (the default) or "700". A CSS font-weight, e.g. "500" or "700". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

monoFont.description: The monospace font stack, for code. A CSS font-family stack. Only fonts already available to the browser. Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

shape.description: Corner radii, from panels down to buttons. Every rounded corner in the app is one of these three, or an offset from one.

radiusLarge.description: Panels, the toolbar and dialogs, e.g. "22px"; "0" for hard corners. A CSS border-radius length, e.g. "12px" or "0". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

radiusMedium.description: Controls, inputs, menus, artwork and content areas, e.g. "12px". A CSS border-radius length, e.g. "12px" or "0". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

radiusSmall.description: Small buttons and thumbnails, e.g. "8px". A CSS border-radius length, e.g. "12px" or "0". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

shadowSmall.description: A small box-shadow, for artwork and thumbnails. A CSS box-shadow, e.g. "0 26px 70px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.34)" or "none". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

shadowMedium.description: A medium box-shadow, for toolbars. A CSS box-shadow, e.g. "0 26px 70px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.34)" or "none". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

shadowLarge.description: A large box-shadow, for panels and dialogs. A CSS box-shadow, e.g. "0 26px 70px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.34)" or "none". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

backdropBlur.description: The backdrop-filter behind translucent surfaces, for example blur(18px). A CSS backdrop-filter, e.g. "blur(18px)" or "none". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

semantic.description: Visual roles. Each is derived from the foundation when absent.

surfacePrimary.description: The main surface colour. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

interactiveActive.description: A pressed or selected control. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

danger.description: Errors and destructive actions. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

accentLift.description: What an accent is mixed toward to read as text or an outline on this theme's surfaces: white on a dark theme, the ink colour on a light one. Derived from the text colour, which is the right answer for both. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

components.description: Values for one class of component, or for one named panel. Each overrides the semantic role it is derived from.

canvas.description: The infinite canvas and its selection chrome.

background.description: The canvas colour. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

backdrop.description: The background behind the canvas: a colour or gradients. A CSS background: a colour, or one or more gradients. Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

gridColor.description: The colour of the canvas grid lines. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

selectionStroke.description: Selection outlines and the glow of the selected panel. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

selectionStrokeWidth.description: The width of the outline around the selected panel, e.g. "1.5px" (the default) or "4px" for a ribbon. A CSS stroke-width, a plain number such as "1.5" or a length such as "4px". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

border.description: The panel border colour. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

divider.description: Dividers inside panels and the toolbar. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

frame.description: The frame around panel content. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

shellBorder.description: The card shell border, as a border shorthand such as "0.5px solid #333". A CSS border shorthand, e.g. "1px solid #333". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

headerForeground.description: Panel titles. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

footerForeground.description: Panel footer metadata. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

shadow.description: The panel shadow. A CSS box-shadow, e.g. "0 26px 70px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.34)" or "none". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

backdropBlur.description: The blur behind a panel. A CSS backdrop-filter, e.g. "blur(18px)" or "none". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

contentBackground.description: The background of the content area inside a panel. Derived from the panel accent when absent; set it to give panels a plain interior with the accent kept to the frame. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

texture.description: A pattern laid over every panel surface. One of: none, paper, dots.

ornament.description: A small figure drawn at the top corner of every panel. One of: none, bow, star.

button.description: Icon buttons in panel headers and footers.

background.description: Resting background. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

border.description: Resting border. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

foreground.description: Icon colour. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

backgroundHover.description: Background under the pointer. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

backgroundActive.description: Background when active or pressed. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

borderActive.description: Border when active. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

foregroundActive.description: Icon colour when active. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

control.description: Other controls: selects, chrome buttons, sliders.

background.description: Resting background. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

borderHover.description: Border under the pointer. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

emptyBackground.description: Buttons in an empty panel. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

emptyBackgroundHover.description: Buttons in an empty panel, under the pointer. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

rangeAccent.description: The accent colour of sliders. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

rangeTrack.description: The line a slider runs along. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

rangeThumb.description: The dot a slider is dragged by. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

rangeWell.description: The surface behind a slider; "transparent" for a bare line. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

rangeWellBorder.description: The border of that surface; "transparent" for none. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

iconStrokeWidth.description: The stroke width of icons, e.g. "2" (the default) or "1.5" for a lighter pen line. A CSS stroke-width, a plain number such as "1.5" or a length such as "4px". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

background.description: Field background. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

foreground.description: Field text. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

background.description: The opaque background of a dropdown list. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

surface.description: The background of a popover menu. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

toolbar.description: The application toolbar across the top.

background.description: Toolbar background. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

border.description: Toolbar border. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

foreground.description: Toolbar text and icons. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

shadow.description: Toolbar shadow. A CSS box-shadow, e.g. "0 26px 70px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.34)" or "none". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

border.description: Dialog border. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

backdrop.description: The dimmed backdrop behind a dialog. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

shadow.description: Dialog shadow. A CSS box-shadow, e.g. "0 26px 70px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.34)" or "none". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

background.description: Editor background. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

border.description: Editor border. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

toolbarBackground.description: The formatting toolbar, which is sticky over the text and needs an opaque surface. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

accent.description: The panel accent colour. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

panelBackground.description: The panel background. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

artworkShadow.description: Shadow under album art. A CSS box-shadow, e.g. "0 26px 70px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.34)" or "none". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

artworkPlaceholder.description: Where album art would be, before there is any. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

artworkPlaceholderHighlight.description: The highlight on the placeholder. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

playlistRowBackground.description: A playlist row. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

playlistRowBackgroundHover.description: A playlist row under the pointer. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

accent.description: The panel accent colour. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

panelBackground.description: The panel background. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

frameBorder.description: A border around the picture, as a border shorthand: a photo matte such as "8px solid #fff", or "none". A CSS border shorthand, e.g. "1px solid #333". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

frameShadow.description: A shadow under the picture, or "none". Not drawn when the edge is torn. A CSS box-shadow, e.g. "0 26px 70px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.34)" or "none". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

edge.description: The edge of the picture. One of: none, deckle.

tilt.description: A rotation of the picture, e.g. "-1.5deg" for a photo glued in by hand; "0deg" (the default) for straight. A CSS angle, e.g. "-1.5deg" or "0deg". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

inset.description: Room kept around the picture inside its stage, e.g. "14px" so a matte, a shadow or a tilt is not clipped; "0px" (the default) fills the stage. A CSS length, e.g. "14px" or "0px". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.

accent.description: The panel accent colour. A CSS colour, e.g. "#1a1612" or "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)". Must not contain url(), var() or other references.
